# OpenClaw MCP-powered Agent Template

version: "0.4.2"

persona:
  name: "My OpenClaw Agent"
  description: "A persistent, stateful MCP-powered agent."
  version: "0.1.0"
  authors: ["You"]
  tags: ["assistant"]

pricing:
  model: "free"  # Options: free, subscription, one_time.
  amount: 0      # Price in USD. Ignored when model is 'free'.
  # billing_period: "monthly" # Options: monthly, annual (for subscription)
  # trial:
  #   enabled: true
  #   days: 7

interface:
  input:
    type: "object"
    required: ["input"]
    properties:
      input:
        type: "string"
        title: "Instruction"
output:
    type: "string"

runtime:
  adapter:
    type: "openclaw"
    # Optional: custom entry_point for OpenClaw
    entry_point: ""

  config:
    model: "gpt-4o"
    temperature: 0.5
    # This becomes your agent's long-term identity
    system_prompt: |
      You are a helpful assistant living in the cloud.
      You have access to a persistent workspace.
      Always check your memory file before answering.

  mode: "full"
  lifecycle: "serverless"
  capabilities:
    manages_own_history: true

  skills:
    # Example: Google Search MCP skill
    - name: "google-search"
      source: "smithery:@mcp/google-search"

policies:
  allow_internet_access: true
  max_steps: 20

.venv
venv
env
virtualenv

__pycache__
*.pyc
*.pyo
*.pyd

.env
.env.local
